review_evidence: The eight Lean files contain over 100 declaration-shaped items centered on signed/unsigned Wadray verification.
WadrayVerification/Aux.lean proves reusable ZMod/Rat cast and valMinAbs lemmas, while WadraySigned.lean develops bounds needed by the verified implementation.
The Sierra artifact is input to the verification and the Lean source is not generated duplicate material.
summary: Retain Wadray verification: its small source set consists of arithmetic lemmas and verified Cairo specifications, with no separable maintenance-only subtree.
